name: Halo of Bones
body:
School necromancy; Level bloodlord 3, death mage 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bone fragment)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 10 mins./level or until expended
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You create a floating disc of bones that hovers behind your head. You create one bone per caster level. As a standard action, you can deploy one of the bones to create a standard human skeleton under your control, or launch it as a projectile at a target within 60 feet.

If you create a skeleton, it persists until destroyed or until the spell ends at which time it crumbles to grave dust. This skeleton does not count against your HD limit for undead controlling but gains the benefits of any feats or abilities that bolster created undead.

If you fire it as a projectile, you must make a standard ranged attack against the target’s AC but using your spellcasting ability modifier in place of your Dexterity modifier, if higher. If the bone-projectile hits, it deals 1d8 piercing damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier and is considered magic for the purposes of bypassing DR.
